description: Scrape AppSumo deal pages directly, search the AppSumo catalog, browse curated collections, or browse a category.

autoEscalateOnBlock.description: If AppSumo starts returning blocks/timeouts, automatically retry with rotating sessions.
autoEscalateOnBlock.title: Auto-escalate on block

categorySlug.description: (Optional) Top-level AppSumo category to browse. Leave empty to skip category browse.
categorySlug.title: Category

dealUrls.description: Direct AppSumo deal URLs, e.g. https://appsumo.com/products/tidycal/.
dealUrls.title: Deal URLs

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted AppSumo deals.
maxItems.title: Max items

proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy configuration used when `useProxy` is true.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchPages.description: How many AppSumo result pages to scan for each search query, category, or collection.
searchPages.title: Search pages per query

searchQueries.description: Search terms to run against the AppSumo catalog, e.g. `calendar`, `crm`, `seo`.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

sortBy.description: Sort order applied to AppSumo search/category/collection browse.
sortBy.title: Sort order

useProxy.description: Route requests through Apify proxy. AppSumo serves datacenter IPs reliably so proxy is off by default.
useProxy.title: Use Apify proxy
